title: Restoration Chamber
keywords: Cleans dirty circuits into matching clean board variants

blocks.text: Cleans dirty circuits into matching clean board variants.

rows: Insert a Dirty circuit in an input slot.
Supply its process cost and leave output room.
Send the resulting board to analysis when a later use requires analysed state.

blocks.text: Damaged circuits belong in Reassembly or Processing, not this cleaning-only path.
